tuningMethod: 5-fold stratified CV on the TRAIN split only (seed 42). Hyperparameter grid + feature-subset (RF importance on train) + clipping on/off compared by CV. Test split evaluated exactly once, after all tuning. Preprocessing re-fitted inside every CV fold. Baselines and the screening model use the same split and the same train-only CV protocol. Decision thresholds are tuned on train CV out-of-fold probabilities only, never on the test set.
